scenes.vo: Got a free MyGroom account? Have you entered this month's prize draw?
Every month, one winner gets something from their own supplement list.
Free accounts enter for free in the app. Open Upgrade, and tap Enter free. Pro accounts are entered automatically.
You just need at least one supplement logged. No purchase needed, and everyone has the same odds.
November's draw closes at the end of Monday.
So, what would you want restocked? Tell us in the comments. And MyGroom's free, link in bio.
